with open('markdown/extensions/toc.py') as f:

# === m1: Add run_postprocessors and render_inner_html ===
m1_functions = '''def run_postprocessors(md, text):
    """Run postprocessors on the given text."""
    for p in md.postprocessors:
        text = p.run(text)
    return text


def render_inner_html(elem):
    """Render the inner HTML of an element (excluding the tag itself)."""
    from markdown import util
    inner = []
    if elem.text:
        inner.append(elem.text)
    for child in elem:
        inner.append(util.etree.tostring(child, encoding='unicode'))
        if child.tail:
            inner.append(child.tail)
    return ''.join(inner)


'''

# Insert after the imports section, before the first function/class
import_end = content.find('\n\n\nclass TocExtension')
if import_end == -1:
    import_end = content.find('\n\n\ndef slugify_unicode')
content = content[:import_end] + '\n' + m1_functions + content[import_end:]

# === m2: Add striptags ===
striptags_func = '''
def striptags(text):
    """Strip HTML tags from text without unescaping entities.
    
    Converts HTML to plain text while preserving entity references like &.
    """
    result = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(text):
        if text[i] == '<':
            # Skip until >
            j = text.find('>', i)
            if j != -1:
                i = j + 1
            else:
                result.append(text[i])
                i += 1
        elif text[i] == '&':
            # Find end of entity
            j = text.find(';', i)
            if j != -1:
                result.append(text[i:j+1])
                i = j + 1
            else:
                result.append(text[i])
                i += 1
        else:
            result.append(text[i])
            i += 1
    return ''.join(result)

'''

# Insert before class TocExtension
class_start = content.find('\n\nclass TocExtension')
content = content[:class_start] + striptags_func + content[class_start:]

with open('markdown/extensions/toc.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

print("m1 and m2 applied")
